bank_account_number.description: The account's number, as the bank prints it. Masked in logs and the audit trail (SEC-15).

bank_name.description: The bank customers pay into, as documents print it.

books_start.description: The date the books start: the first financial year begins on it.

document_footer.description: The text at the foot of every document.

email.description: The address documents give for questions.

first_year_end.description: The last day of the first financial year: the day before a year starts, after the books start, so the first year may be shorter or longer than twelve months.

fy_start_month.description: The month each financial year starts in, 1 (January) to 12.

legal_name.description: The legal name, as registered with ACRA.

mailing_address.description: Where post goes, when not to the registered address.

paynow_uen.description: The UEN customers pay to by PayNow.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the organisation's days are counted in.

uen.description: The Unique Entity Number: 9 or 10 capital letters and digits.

version.description: The organisation's version; it also makes the ETag.
